timestamp_skew.definition: X-SePay-Timestamp minus local receipt time in seconds; the local clock was checked against NTP (offset < 0.1 s)
timestamp_skew.conclusion: systematic on SePay's side: the header is 151.8-154.0 s behind receipt on every delivery, first attempts and retries alike, while transactionDate agrees with the receipt clock; a 300 s tolerance keeps about 146 s of headroom and any tolerance under about 160 s would reject valid deliveries
